newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Telefonica de Argentina upped.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Telefonica de Argentina upped.

text.p: -- CS First Boston said on Tuesday it upgraded its coverage of Telefonica de Argentina SA to buy from hold.

-- Analysts Luann Zurlo and Trey Vincent said in report they based their upgrade on a recovery in fourth-quarter operating earnings; expectations of a resolution to a rate rebalancing issue soon, "which may be less negative to revenues than previously anticipated; and low valuation."
-- "We believe that we have reached the point where TAR is more likely to surprise on the upside than downside, given negative consensus and recently lowered earnings expectations."
-- They kept their fiscal 1997 estimate of $2 per American Depositary Receipt (ADR) and set an estimate of $2.30 for fiscal 1998.
-- Telefonica ADRs opened up 1/2 to 24-1/2 in New York.
